description_for_human: Read-only lookups of Esko WebCenter projects, design specs and documents.
description_for_model: Read-only access to Esko WebCenter, the company's packaging project system: projects, their attributes (design specs such as style, board grade, flute and dimensions), status, managers, documents including ArtiosCAD designs, document versions and history, users, groups and to-do lists. Use it whenever the user asks about a WebCenter project, a packaging design or its specs. It cannot change data.
